info.title: CommercePay API
info.description: --- **Credentials Accounts** Every account is provided with separate keys for testing and for running live transactions. Once the merchant application has been approved, developers can begin the process of integrating the CommercePay API. The following details will be provided to get started with the integration. Get Started

post.description: The following input parameters are expected to be provided by the Merchant to retrieve the access token.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country code with 2-letter of ISO Alpha-2 standard

get.description: The following input parameters are expected to be provided by the merchant to retrieve available channels by country code.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: An identifier that represents a CommercePay channel. Refer to the id on response endpoints of GetTenantChannelsByCountry.

get.description: The following input parameters are expected to be provided by the merchant to retrieve available payment provider channels.

Payment gateway checks the existing payment status. The following input parameters are expected to be provided by the merchant to verify transaction status or to obtain more details on the payment before approving the customer’s order. > Endpoint requires signature security checking.
> For signature generation, please refer to the > Online Documentation URL.

parameters.name: TransactionNumber
parameters.description: Unique CAP Transaction Number **(Conditional: If it is query for specific transaction in either normal transaction or session transaction, then need pass the transaction number)**

parameters.name: cap-signature
parameters.description: Refer to more information on Hash Generation

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description:
Generated from Response accessToken (/api/TokenAuth/Authenticate)
Keyword Bearer with single SPACE, following with {accessToken}

parameters.name: SessionNumber
parameters.description: Unique CAP Session Number **(Conditional: If the query is query the session, then need pass the session number)**

> For signature generation, please refer to the > Online Documentation URL.

**Pre add customer payer payment details in Payment Gateway** Allow merchants save their customer payment details and using their system generated Unique Id to identify each of customers. > - Merchants shall pass their customers Unique Id to **"customer.username"** parameter > - Merchants may get customers saved payment details by using [Check Saved Payment Endpoint](/api-reference/check-saved-payment) > - Channel Id may refer to the [Get Channel List Endpoint](/api-reference/get-tenant-channels-by-country) > Endpoint requires signature security checking.
